description: A dim wooden hall with bare plank walls and rafters, lit by wall-mounted oil lamps. Men in suits and fedoras sit on rough benches with many hands raised, and a preacher stands at a small table stacked with crates at the far end. The floor is littered with scraps of paper. A man in the foreground bows his head with his hands at his face, and the scene reads as a crowded, emotional gathering.
